title: Filter authorized Command Work Queue by exact responsible owner with cursor-safe native navigation
goal: Provide a bounded Class-0 exact owner filter on the existing single six-view Work Queue; preserve server-side Incident/Task ACLs, status/SLA/freshness semantics and revocation-safe pagination.
invariants: Only the current host-Session principal/tenant/environment and per-object Owner.CanRead grant visibility; owner parameter is never authentication or assignment mutation.
Apply the literal owner equality after authorization, before SLA-risk diagnostics and source freshness for an excluded item; no inaccessible item influences counts, warnings or result.
Keep exactly the existing six system views, one host-owned route and Class-0 status/order/cursor navigation; no additional provider reads or external dependencies.
Cursor digest includes owner filter and current authorized rows, so changing owner scope or revoking a row invalidates prior pagination.
OPEN-013 Class-2 assignment and ownership changes remain excluded; the source owner string is only a read-only filter.
security_properties: Untrusted owner query parameter bounded to 128 bytes, UTF-8 and no controls, rejected before host session and owner calls.
Never project a denied or cross-tenant Item; empty/unknown selection does not reveal candidate identities.
HTML uses native escaping and url.QueryEscape; selection and pagination always reauthorize on new requests.

migration.rationale: Opt-in query parameter/response field; legacy requests and existing source schema unchanged.

rollback.strategy: Remove optional owner filter while preserving earlier status filter and stable cursor behavior.
verification: Legacy six-view, sorting, paging, source freshness and filtered SLA regressions all remain valid.

inputs: Read AGENTS.md and AI_START_HERE.md, official CAP-CMD-101 all 27 sections, Command Incident/Task objects and permission/pagination contracts; current source 170 HEAD d7ac9d3c4141c186722862a383dcb3e97e9d9f10, both exact-HEAD GitHub Actions SUCCESS.
E10-CMD-101J-DIAGNOSTICS already IMPLEMENTED in graph and PR #170 remains DRAFT with parent #169 frozen; no unapproved canonical action required.
outputs: Existing Command GET /command/work-queue accepts optional owner=exact-value and filters currently readable responsible-owner Incident/Task rows in all six views, preserving exact status/order.
Native HTML form/links and selected-item controls preserve the owner filter across views/cursor pages and reset cursor when filter edited.
No out-of-owner SLA unavailable warning or source freshness failure; correctly maintain warnings from included authorized items.
acceptance_tests: Owner 'analyst' SLA-risk/status group ignores authorized other-owner missing SLA and denied foreign/secret objects; owner 'other' preserves relevant unknown SLA warning; no changed permissions.

Navigate first and second owner-filtered pages of 75 readable Tasks, select the 70th item on page two with same filter and authorized cursor; changing owner scope or revoking its ACL yields generic 404 and no result.
Reject invalid, duplicate and oversized owner query before session; preserve HTML encoding and no source previews; keep legacy no-owner behavior.
Run Command Go runtime Linux/macOS/Windows and engineering-kernel unchanged mandatory changed security critical >=90% plus SAST; do not claim acceptance from an open PR.

performance_budget.rationale: One exact string equality per already owner-authorized bounded work item; no extra Owner.List or CanRead calls; pagination digest includes single filter string.
metrics: <=5000 owner candidates, <=50 visible rows/page, no new sources or per-item queries.
